fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: AI Chat tile: answers questions from live ERPNext data with Claude or Gemini, read-only. Queries run as the logged-in user, so ERPNext permissions apply unless Full Read Access is on.

fields.default:
System Manager
Accounts Manager
Accounts User
fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: One role per line. Users need one of these (Administrator always can).

fields.label: Full Read Access
fields.description: The AI reads every record regardless of the user's own ERPNext permissions (other branches, cost and valuation, HR and payroll). Anyone in Allowed Roles can then see all of it through AI Chat. Off = each user sees only what they can read in the desk.

fields.label: Default Provider
fields.description: Pre-selected on the chat page; users can switch per new chat.

fields.label: Anthropic API Key
fields.description: From console.anthropic.com. Blank = Claude not offered.

fields.label: Claude Model
fields.description: claude-haiku-5-5 (default, cheapest), claude-sonnet-5-5, or claude-opus-5-5 (most capable, ~40x the cost of Haiku).

fields.label: Claude Effort
fields.description: How much the model thinks. low is enough for these lookups and uses the fewest tokens.

fields.label: Google API Key
fields.description: From aistudio.google.com, on a project with billing turned on: on the free tier Google may use prompts and returned data to improve its models. Blank = Gemini not offered.

fields.label: Gemini Model
fields.description: Model code from ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models: gemini-3.5-flash-lite (default, cheapest) or gemini-3.8-flash.

fields.label: Usage Limits
fields.description: Quick buttons (Sales today, Outstanding, Stock…) are answered locally and never count.

fields.label: AI Questions per User per Day
AI Questions per Chat
fields.description: Each question re-sends the whole chat, so long chats cost more. After this, the user is asked to start a new chat. 0 = no limit.

fields.label: Answer Reuse
fields.description: A question asked again (same words, or near-identical with a typo; names, numbers and dates must match) re-runs the earlier answer's data lookups for live figures instead of letting the AI work it out again. Only the first question of a chat is saved, since follow-ups depend on the chat before them.

fields.label: Reply On Reuse
fields.description: AI Rewrite: the chat's provider writes the answer from the fresh data on its cheapest model, without tools (a fraction of the tokens). Tables Only: the data is shown as tables, no AI call, zero tokens.

fields.label: Word Similarity
fields.description: 0–1. Each word must be at least this similar to its partner (0.85 lets 'outstandng' match 'outstanding'). 1 = exact words only.

fields.label: Forget After (days)
fields.description: A saved recipe older than this is asked to the AI again and refreshed. 0 = never.

fields.label: Extra System Prompt
fields.description: Added to the built-in instructions, e.g. business terms or how to name branches.
